name: October Pharma
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing) | EGXGAP 17 Nov 2026: the audited FY2025 results were published on the Egyptian Exchange and carry net profit EGP 205,723,937 against an audited FY2024 comparative of EGP 151,838,850 (October Pharma, disclosure EGS380R1C018, audit status audited, mirrored at https://english.mubasher.info/news/4580040/October-Pharma-OCPH-CA-Reports-Year-Ended-31-12-2025-Results and https://askborsa.com/en/company/OCPH/fy-2025, both read 17 Nov 2026). The stored FY2024 net profit of EGP 151,840,000 reproduces that audited comparative, so the stored series is consistent with the filing. No FY2025 period is appended here: the disclosure publishes the net profit and the board report but the exchange attachments are image-only scans (zero extractable characters, OCR recovers only letterhead), so revenue, cost of sales, operating lines, tax and EPS for FY2025 could not be read and writing a column with one populated cell and nine blanks would misrepresent the year. Fill this year only from the filing or a machine-readable annual report.
note: Figures in the unit shown, converted from the provider's millions EGP. Each fiscal year header cell was matched to its own data cell, so the provider trailing twelve month column is excluded. Every printed identity ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit.
